reuse.why: Fintegra goes through new shared linkExternalAccount/linkSyncServerAccount and downloadSimpleProviderTransactions, which the existing providers now use as well, plus the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked and findOrCreateBank.

duplication.why: Instead of a sixth copy of the link and download flows, the per-provider copies are collapsed into one implementation with provider-specific arguments.

placement.why: Shared link flow stays in accounts/app.ts, the download helper in accounts/sync.ts, config and types where their siblings are.

scope.why: Adds the provider but also rewrites all five existing link functions and two download functions, a sizeable unrequested refactor bundled into a feature change (and drops the Enable Banking bank-key comment).

maintainability.why: One link flow with explicit options (bankKey, mask, fileId, syncedTables) is much easier to own; the two-layer linkSyncServerAccount/linkExternalAccount typing with Omit<Parameters<...>> is a bit intricate.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All providers, including Fintegra, go through linkExternalAccount and assertBankAccountNotLinked.

disguised_duplication.where: Copies were removed rather than reshaped.
